name: Gas N Chaos
summary:
# Welcome to the messiest Gas Station in VR! ⛽

Run your own station, serve a nonstop line of strange customers, and decide every shift: do the job properly, or turn the whole place upside down.

**⛽ Fuel Cars & Serve Customers**

Grab the nozzle, fill up tanks, take payment and keep the queue moving. Fast, clean service means bigger tips and happier drivers or you can "accidentally" spray fuel across the lot and watch it all fall apart.
